mainEntity.name: How fast can someone get here after a storm damages the inside of my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A true emergency response is typically same-day or within hours, especially when there is active leaking, soaked ceilings, or electrical risk. In Denver-area storms, response speed can vary with demand, but calling immediately improves the chance of limiting secondary damage and getting drying started before mold becomes a bigger issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Emergency crews often respond the same day or within hours, but the fastest help usually goes to homes with active leaks, safety hazards, or major water intrusion.
